title: I'm a USB-C Maximalist
summary: A tech blogger shares their experience and advocacy for USB-C as the universal connectivity standard, discussing how they've consolidated their device ecosystem around USB-C and the benefits they've experienced from this standardization approach.
problem_solved: Addresses device fragmentation and cable clutter by advocating for USB-C as a universal standard
why_valuable: The consolidation of charging and data cables reduces e-waste and simplifies daily tech usage for consumers
